Source snapshot: Apple Inc. 2025 Form 10-K, SEC EDGAR, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019325000079/aapl-20250927.htm
Filing date: 2025-10-31
Period of report: 2025-09-27
Snapshot date: 2026-05-21

Apple 2025 Form 10-K evidence says Services gross margin percentage increased during 2025 compared to 2024 primarily due to a different mix of services, partially offset by higher costs.

Apple 2025 Form 10-K evidence says Services gross margin percentage was 75.4% in 2025, 73.9% in 2024, and 70.8% in 2023.

Apple 2025 Form 10-K evidence says Research and development expense was $34,550 million in 2025, $31,370 million in 2024, and $29,915 million in 2023.

Apple 2025 Form 10-K evidence says the growth in R&D expense during 2025 compared to 2024 was primarily driven by increases in headcount-related expenses and infrastructure-related costs.

Apple 2025 Form 10-K evidence says cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities totaled $132.4 billion as of September 27, 2025.

Apple 2025 Form 10-K evidence says Apple had outstanding fixed-rate notes with an aggregate principal amount of $91.3 billion, with $12.4 billion payable within 12 months.

Apple 2025 Form 10-K evidence says Apple had manufacturing purchase obligations of $56.2 billion, with $55.4 billion payable within 12 months.

Apple 2025 Form 10-K evidence says Apple has a large global business and a significant majority of manufacturing is performed by outsourcing partners located primarily in China mainland, India, Japan, South Korea, Taiwan, and Vietnam.

Apple 2025 Form 10-K evidence says future gross margins can be impacted by factors including industry-wide product pricing pressures, increased competition, compressed product life cycles, supply shortages, tariffs, and macroeconomic pressure.

Apple 2025 Form 10-K evidence says the company faces competition and that increased competition can affect net sales and gross margins.
